title: The little clock that said " I won't "
text:
The little clock that said " I won't ". After one hour of receiving it, the clock was going back....fast.
The only good thing about this clock is the slick look.
It is impossible to set because the buttons are so small no one in our household could work them.
The black on black did not help either.
In my opinion, even one star is too much.
I did not think that I needed a PhD to set a clock.
Stay away from it, because to add insult to injury, you will be charged a shipping fee for returning it.
And returning....you will.
